# Hyprism Team

> Hyprism Team is a small, independent developer team. The team publishes open source software and currently focuses on Hyprism, an unofficial Hytale launcher.

## Hyprism

Hyprism is a desktop launcher for Hytale. The public website presents its current interface and links to the source repository. The project is intended for managing Hytale game instances, installed mods, and user profiles. The repository is the authoritative source for implementation details, supported platforms, installation steps, release status, and licensing.

- [Source repository](https://github.com/hyprismteam/Hyprism)
- [Releases](https://github.com/hyprismteam/Hyprism/releases)
- [Documentation](https://hyprismteam.github.io/Hyprism/docs/)
- [Contributors](https://github.com/hyprismteam/Hyprism/graphs/contributors)
